messages:
Sam (docs): Heads-up — found mismatch in the API ref for the streaming generate endpoint. The docs example shows Content-Type: application/json and a single JSON response, but our runtime streams SSE events with 'event:' and 'data:' lines. This will confuse users implementing SSE clients. :eyes:

Jordan (eng-runtime): Good catch. Our SSE contract is: each event is either "partial" or "done", and the data payload is JSON with keys like "text" and "delta". The docs currently show the whole response as one JSON object. We should update the curl example, add a canonical SSE snippet, and include a non-streaming example (stream=false).

Maria (eng-ml): Also flag that the embeddings docs had a similar mismatch last quarter — suggest adding a short migration note so integrators know to switch parsing strategies.

Rach (product): Agree. Can we add a one-line migration blurb: "If you previously parsed the entire response as JSON, switch to consuming SSE events and assembling the final output, or set stream=false to get a single JSON response."

Sam (docs): I'll open a docs PR with the fixes. Proposed changes:
- replace the incorrect JSON example with an SSE curl example using Accept: text/event-stream
- add a canonical SSE snippet showing event: partial / event: done pairs with data payloads
- add Node/Python SDK snippets (stream listener vs await)
- add a short migration note about Content-Type and stream=true/false behavior

Jordan (eng-runtime): Please add me as reviewer. Also, update the SDK test harness to assert SSE event names and that the data JSON includes "text" and "delta" keys.

Sam (docs): Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1745 — will populate with samples. Quick copy of the planned samples below.

Sam (docs): ```bash
curl -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/stream
```

Sam (docs): ```sse
event: partial
data: {"text":"Hel","delta":"Hel"}

event: partial
data: {"text":"lo","delta":"lo"}

event: done
data: {"text":"Hello","delta":"","final":true}
```

Rach (product): :thumbsup: That SSE sample looks clear. For the SDK snippets keep them tiny — just show how to attach a stream listener and assemble deltas into the final text.

docs-bot: PR opened by Sam (docs) — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1745 assigned to Jordan (eng-runtime) for review.

Jordan (eng-runtime): Reviewing now. I'll push a small runtime test tweak to ensure our test payloads include the "delta" field and that event names match. Expect comments in the PR within the hour.

Sam (docs): Thanks — I'll add the migration blurb and a non-streaming example (stream=false) before merging.

Maria (eng-ml): One more ask: add the plain JSON example for clients that prefer a single response (example with stream=false) and a sentence about Content-Type differences (text/event-stream vs application/json).

Sam (docs): Will do. Plan: update PR, merge after Jordan's review, then ping SDK owners to refresh snippets in the language-specific docs.

Jordan (eng-runtime): :shipit:
